t: session_count increments only for user-initiated sessions; agent sessions tracked separately
challenge: session_count in WAI-State.json increments at closeout for all session types including agent-initiated sessions. This distorts session metrics and any per-session analytics.
hypothesis: User-prompt-submit hook captures session_type (user|agent) and passes it to closeout. Closeout conditionally increments session_count only for user-initiated sessions. Agent sessions tracked under a separate counter or logged differently.
next_step: update hook + closeout to capture and conditionally use session_type

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Improvement idea: distinguish user vs agent sessions in session_count.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to implement immediately without user direction.
